youtube.baslik: Does a no-response mark mean no hearing at all? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: If there is no response even at the audiometer's maximum output, it is recorded as no response, or NR. No response does not mean there is no hearing; it only shows that the threshold is worse than the audiometer can measure.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Does a no-response mark mean no hearing at all?
bilgiler: With no response at maximum output, NR is recorded.
In air conduction, the symbol sits at the device limit with an outward arrow.
No response does not mean there is no hearing at all.

cumleler: Does a no-response mark mean no hearing at all?
If even the maximum output gets no response, it is marked NR.
For air conduction, the symbol sits at the limit, arrow slanting outward.
No-response symbols are never connected with lines.
No response does not mean there is no hearing at all.
It shows the threshold is worse than the device can measure.
